title: Update on my auto-battler: The combat scene no longer has a hideous gray background
author: Odd-Sympathy-9556
selftext:
I posted [here](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1q8db6y/generating_useful_background_images/) a month ago asking for help generating usable background images for my combat scene. The responses helped a lot and I wanted to share where things are at now.

Darkest Exiles is a guild management sim for iOS where you're the guild master, not the hero. You scout and train adepts, promote them to heroes, and send them into branching dungeons. The gif shows a combat that is fully automated and runs on a 2x4 grid. The goal is to have it semi-automated in the future by adding an instructions system for heroes.

I'm at the point now where I'd love people to actually play it and tell me what feels off. The balance is still rough in places and there are definitely bugs lurking, but the core loop is there. I'd really appreciate the feedback.

\- Beta TestFlight: [https://testflight.apple.com/join/zYhwZz46](https://testflight.apple.com/join/zYhwZz46)

Happy to talk about any of the AI workflows if anyone's curious!

comments.author: SkyNetLive
comments.body: this looks awesome. I wonder if I can use my own assets to swap the characters? I didnt mean to elf promote but I am making altplayer which is mostly manga and card battle AI assistance. I was hoping to try character generation next. Or could you recommend such a sample project  where i can swap assets? I love auto battlers

replies.author: CosmikStudios
replies.body: To be honest, I have no idea because I've never tried such a thing. But if I had to guess, any engine (Unity, Godot and so on) must have "sample" projects where you can just plug'n'play stuff for sure.

comments.author: galaxymedia
comments.body: I'd be interested to know the framework and art approach if using AI. Are you using react native? Fully native? An engine?

replies.author: CosmikStudios
replies.body:
Fully iOS native with SwiftUI and SpriteKit. I work as an iOS developer and since it's my first game ever, I thought it would be a waste not to use what I already know.  
  
Regarding the art approach it really depends on what you're asking about because it's one of the hardest things I've dealt (and deal) with. Maintaining consistency is the hardest thing ever and because I've used different workflows/platforms for it, it becomes even harder. But I always try to use the same core "artistic style" in prompts to aim for similarities, otherwise it's chaos.

If I had to do it all over again, I'd probably just commit 100% to one single platform instead.

replies.author: galaxymedia
replies.body:
That's a great response, thank you. I've also struggled with the consistency on art style generation and I'm not quite prepared to pay any of the AI wrappers that claim to solve it 🙂

Good luck, looks like a great game!

comments.author: Lopsided-Chance-9956
comments.body:
This is so rad and inspiring! The game mechanics and ui looks like a lot of thought has been put into it I like it.

  
I guess a step would be to make the battling animation feel natural/give players that cool feeling?

  
Thanks for this post though, will make me less lazy about my own game dev journey.

replies.author: CosmikStudios
replies.body:
Thanks for the comment! I share the same lazyness, you're not alone 😅

I wonder what do you mean about the animation feel natural and/or the cool feeling for players? Could you be more specific? I'll take any feedback - thanks!

replies.author: Lopsided-Chance-9956
replies.body:
It may be worth adding a walking animation and timing it vs the idle state gliding look. 

My thought too with is it to add stuff like easing potentially vs linear frames for all or give each character a bit more feeling in weight. I could be wrong but like walking speed even or your frame attack rotation being faster for ranged and slower for melees? These things are hard to feel until you play around with it though imo. It doesn't have to affect the damage modifiers, but just the look of it.

I guess one thing though, is to think about the dopamine hit of getting a powerful character and getting that visual bang as well? 



Not that it all doesn't look awesome right now. What you made is so sick!!!

comments.author: DreamNotDeferred
comments.body: Looks great, let me know when you're testing for Android, please.
